fidelity: F2a -- Physics-Lumped Stack Model (Nernst + overpotentials + SOC/Br2/thermal ODE)
source: Lim et al. (1977) J. Electrochem. Soc. 124, 1154; Skyllas-Kazacos et al. (2011) J. Electrochem. Soc. 158, R55; Wu & Zhao et al. (2017) Energy Convers. Manage. 138, 271; Suresh et al. (2018) RSC Adv. 8, 13374; Newman & Thomas-Alyea (2004) Electrochemical Systems

unit.name: Generic 60-cell ZBFB stack, 1000 cm2 electrode area (hybrid Zn plating)

E0.note: Standard cell potential E0(Br2/Br-) - E0(Zn2+/Zn) ~= 1.087 - (-0.763) V

c_Br2_max_M.note: Soluble Br2/Br3- (complexed) concentration in the positive electrolyte at SOC=1
c_Br2_max_M.source: Wang et al. (2018) bromine complexing agent loading

areal_capacity_Ah_cm2.note: Plating-limited zinc areal capacity (~60 mAh/cm2). Higher loading promotes dendrites/shorting; usable charge scales with electrode area, not tank volume.
areal_capacity_Ah_cm2.source: Suresh et al. (2018) RSC Adv. 8, 13374; Skyllas-Kazacos et al. (2011)

j0_A_cm2.note: Lumped exchange current density (Zn deposition + Br2/Br- redox)
j0_A_cm2.source: Newman & Thomas-Alyea (2004); Wu & Zhao et al. (2017)

R_cell_ohm_cm2_ref.note: Area-specific cell resistance at T_ref; ZBFB higher than VRFB due to membrane + Br2 complexing agent

E_a_R.note: Arrhenius activation energy for cell resistance
E_a_R.source: Islam et al. (2017) J. Power Sources 349, 139

jL_ref_A_cm2.note: Mass-transport limiting current density at reference flow
jL_ref_A_cm2.source: Wu & Zhao et al. (2017) Energy Convers. Manage. 138, 271

flow_ref_Lpm.note: Reference electrolyte volumetric flow rate for jL

dOCV_dT.note: Entropic temperature coefficient for Zn(s)+Br2(l)->ZnBr2; dE0/dT = -dS_rxn/(nF), dS ~ -30 J/mol/K -> ~ -1.5e-4 V/K (corrected from Zn/Br2 entropy)
dOCV_dT.source: Lim et al. (1977); Atkins Physical Chemistry (2014) thermodynamic data

cp_stack.note: Effective heat capacity (aqueous ZnBr2 electrolyte dominated, ~3-3.5 kJ/kg/K)

hA.note: Lumped heat-loss coefficient * area to ambient

k_sd_per_s.note: First-order Br2 self-discharge / crossover (shuttle) rate constant. Drives coulombic efficiency below 1 (typical ZBFB CE ~0.85-0.95).
k_sd_per_s.source: Wang, Lai et al. (2018) bromine complexing agents and self-discharge; Skyllas-Kazacos et al. (2011)
